$doc: The PROMPT-SIZE ratchet (2026-08-18 audit) — the lint-ratchet idiom pointed at the instruction surface, which had grown to ~16k tokens per orchestrator wake with no gauge (the one doctrine budget with no harness). Budgets are CHARS of static payload per surface, measured from the BUILT registries + composed contracts by apps/desktop/src/main/promptmeter.ts and asserted by promptbudget.test.ts on every test run. Shrink-only: lowering a number is routine; RAISING one is a deliberate, reviewed act naming what grew and why, in the same commit — exactly the lint-ratchet contract. Values sit ~3% above the post-diet measurement so ordinary wording tweaks don't trip it while a new 2k-char rider does. RAISES: 2026-08-20 registry.triage 31990→32100 + registry.own 31540→31650 (list_playbooks + run_playbook, the marketing-os playbook catalog on rex's belt) and registry.bus 11150→11700 (search_x on research legs); 2026-08-21 registry.triage 32100→32450 + registry.own 31650→32000 (round 3: run_playbook's description now teaches its TWO lanes — subtask-in-task-thread vs hands-off unit — and the no-approval-stop contract) — docs/design/marketing-os-2026-08; 2026-08-22 registry.triage 32450→33450 + registry.own 32000→33020 (reply-radar: draft_replies + revise_replies — the reply card is a distinct trade from draft_posts, and its target/source/metrics shape is what stops a web-found row carrying invented numbers) and registry.bus 11700→12100 (the worker copy of draft_replies: the leg that FOUND the conversations hands them over) — docs/design/reply-radar-2026-08; 2026-08-26 contract.orchestrator 12650→13270 (triage-preflight: RESOLVE DEPENDENCIES BEFORE YOU DELEGATE — the ruling that a missing connector is a card the human clicks, not a task filed for later; the live failure it ends staffed a run that could not read what it was asked to read) — docs/design/triage-preflight-2026-08. ; 2026-09-08 contract.orchestrator 13270→13700 + contract.orchestrator.sweeps 5010→5170 + registry.triage 33450→35100 + registry.own 33020→34700 (accept on the human's WORD: the Accept button left every surface, accept_task joined the belt with the server's evidence rule in its description, and GATES / the watchdog sweep / the style rules now say the word is the road) — docs/35 §5, the thread-status round.
